related.title: IBM transmon：電容與充電能量預算
related.titleEn: IBM transmon: capacitance and charging-energy budget
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：方案需滿足錯誤預算、峰值庫存與300s深度下限；未知硬體參數用區間而非單一精確值。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Require error budget, peak inventory and300s depth floor; represent unknown hardware parameters as ranges. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 建立『IBM transmon：電容與充電能量預算』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付80/100 fF能量表、單位鏈與待確認的 E_J 欄位。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'IBM transmon: capacitance and charging-energy budget', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver an80/100 fF energy table, unit chain, and unresolved E_J field.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。教學T態需求10^8，10個工廠各10000態/s，邏輯深度下限300s；每工廠1000物理位元，資料區20000位元。 T供=10^8/(10×10000)。 代入 1e8/(10*10000)，得到 1000 s。供應時間T供=N_T/(F R工廠)，總時間至少max(T供,T深度)；實際路由、依賴及庫存可能增加時間。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：E_C=e²/(2C)，以 E_C/h 表示頻率；只描述集中電容，不包含接面損耗或完整能階。 使用合成電容 C=80 fF，e=1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ C，h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J·s。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(1.602176634e-19)**2/(2*80e-15*6.62607015e-34)/1e6，另開一欄執行獨立核對：另以 C×(E_C/h) 的不變性檢查兩組，並驗證 fF→F 的10⁻¹⁵換算。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Teaching demand10^8T states,10 factories at10000 states/s each,depth floor300s,1000 physical qubits/factory and20000 data-region qubits. Tsupply=10^8/(10×10000). Substituting 1e8/(10*10000) gives 1000 s. Supply timeTsupply=NT/(F Rfactory), with total time at leastmax(Tsupply,Tdepth); routing, dependencies and inventory may add time. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: E_C=e²/(2C), expressed as frequency E_C/h; this lumped-capacitance model excludes junction loss and the full spectrum. Use Synthetic C=80 fF, e=1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ C, h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J·s. Evaluate nominal expression (1.602176634e-19)**2/(2*80e-15*6.62607015e-34)/1e6 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Independently check the invariant C×(E_C/h) and the10⁻¹⁵ conversion from fF to F.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Rigetti 多晶片耦合器：交換振盪與 iSWAP 時序
related.titleEn: Rigetti multi-chip coupler: exchange oscillations and iSWAP timing
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：方案需滿足錯誤預算、峰值庫存與300s深度下限；未知硬體參數用區間而非單一精確值。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Require error budget, peak inventory and300s depth floor; represent unknown hardware parameters as ranges. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 建立『Rigetti 多晶片耦合器：交換振盪與 iSWAP 時序』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付雙曲線、單激發守恆表與人口／相位分開的驗收紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Rigetti multi-chip coupler: exchange oscillations and iSWAP timing', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver two curves, single-excitation conservation and separate population/phase acceptance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。教學T態需求10^8，10個工廠各10000態/s，邏輯深度下限300s；每工廠1000物理位元，資料區20000位元。 T供=10^8/(10×10000)。 代入 1e8/(10*10000)，得到 1000 s。供應時間T供=N_T/(F R工廠)，總時間至少max(T供,T深度)；實際路由、依賴及庫存可能增加時間。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：共振單激發子空間用P交換=sin²(gt)，g以rad/s；全交換時長π/(2g)，忽略失諧與損耗。 使用合成g/(2π)=5 MHz；求全交換時間，並與4 MHz比較。 以手算或試算表計算名義式pi/(2*2*pi*5e6)*1e9，另開一欄執行獨立核對：以g×t=π/2核對兩組；交換人口到1仍須獨立測量相位才能辨識iSWAP。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Teaching demand10^8T states,10 factories at10000 states/s each,depth floor300s,1000 physical qubits/factory and20000 data-region qubits. Tsupply=10^8/(10×10000). Substituting 1e8/(10*10000) gives 1000 s. Supply timeTsupply=NT/(F Rfactory), with total time at leastmax(Tsupply,Tdepth); routing, dependencies and inventory may add time. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: In the resonant single-excitation subspace Pswap=sin²(gt), with g in rad/s; full exchange takesπ/(2g), excluding detuning and loss. Use Synthetic g/(2π)=5 MHz; solve full-exchange duration and compare4 MHz. Evaluate nominal expression pi/(2*2*pi*5e6)*1e9 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check g×t=π/2 for both cases; unit transfer population still needs phase measurement to identify iSWAP.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
